one_line: Young, college-educated, science-of-mind curious follower of Perception Box across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. Skews female and queer-inclusive, lives in tech and college metros, listens to neuroscience and contemplative podcasts, reads psychology, and treats mental fitness the way a runner treats training.

demographics.age_range: 18 to 44 with the mass in 25-34 (31.7%, idx 240) and 18-24 (29.6%, idx 305). 35-44 still reads 133. 45-54 falls to 62, 55-64 to 26, 65+ to 9. This is the youngest-skewing of the consciousness lenses.
demographics.gender_skew: Female 62.6% (idx 126), male 35.5% (idx 74), non-binary 1.4% (idx 94). More men here than in the Unlikely Collaborators follower; the neuroscience and rationalist voices (Huberman, Sam Harris, Lex Fridman) pull a meaningful male third.
demographics.income_band: Solid middle to upper-middle. $75K-$99K idx 148, $100K-$149K idx 118, $50K-$74K idx 115. $250K+ reads 55 and under $25K reads 79. Comfortable, not wealthy; spends on subscriptions, supplements, and studios rather than luxury goods.
demographics.education: Bachelors 34.2% (idx 152), some college 26.3% (idx 125), graduate or professional 15.6% (idx 90). High school or less reads 54. Reads at a college register and is comfortable with research-paper framing.
geo_skew: San Francisco Oakland San Jose CA
demographics.life_stage: Single 39.3% (idx 126) and in a relationship 22.9% (idx 351); married reads 56. Six in ten have no children at home. Occupation lifts on legal (248), education and library (157), management and professional (122), and STEM (118). Skilled trades, manufacturing, and transportation all read under 50.

values: Mental fitness as a daily practice backed by science. Mental Health interest 82% (idx 624), Meditation 78% (idx 198), Sleeping and Relaxing 40% (idx 2,714), Alternative Medicine 39% (idx 1,661).

Understanding the mind over fixing the self. Hidden Brain (idx 2,998), Ten Percent Happier (11,017), On Being (10,040), The Science of Happiness (2,487), The Science of Perception Box (1,213), Psychology Today (598), TED Talks (726).

Big-tent intellectual curiosity. Sam Harris (idx 3,712), Lex Fridman (1,446), Scott Barry Kaufman (3,970), Rick Hanson (2,287), Dr Rhonda Patrick (2,570), Peter Attia (1,466), Ezra Klein (1,031), Math and Stats interest (2,999), News-Tech (1,511), Nerd Culture (1,487).

Contemplative and therapist voices held alongside the scientists. Tara Brach (1,773), Krista Tippett (654), Esther Perel (610), Brene Brown (701), Nedra Glover Tawwab (1,978), Dr Nicole LePera (1,566), Dan Harris (1,000), Deepak Chopra (1,235).

Queer belonging and progressive causes. LGBTQ+ 23% (idx 199), LGBTQ Life 39% (1,929), LGBTQ Activism 28% (2,176), Social Justice 27% (1,526). ACLU 31% (2,291), The Trevor Project 31% (1,733), GLAAD 21% (4,044), Color of Change (3,816), Innocence Project (2,443), Human Rights Watch (2,326).

Clean-label nutrition and supplements as part of the practice. Bloom Nutrition 48% (idx 3,663), Thorne 25% (1,293), AG1 (711), Quest Nutrition 54% (1,696), OLIPOP 19% (676), Sakara Life 21% (5,971), Sweetgreen 18% (484), Health Nut (5,815), SunLife Organics (2,853).

psychographics.tone_they_respond_to: Calm, evidence-first, generous. Explains a mechanism before giving advice. Interviews over hot takes. Comfortable with uncertainty and with saying 'the research is mixed'. Dry humor about the human condition, never at a group's expense. Names the study, then tells you what it means for Tuesday morning.
psychographics.tone_they_reject: Outrage-bait, grindset and alpha framing, prosperity-gospel positivity, cable-news shouting, miracle-cure wellness claims with no mechanism, male-gaze fitness marketing, and anything that reduces a person to a demographic or a diagnosis.

filter_rules_for_agent: KEEP anything about how the mind works: perception, cognitive bias, attention, habit formation, neuroscience, psychology research, memory, decision science. Hidden Brain, Huberman Lab, Ten Percent Happier, The Science of Happiness, The Science of Perception Box, Scott Barry Kaufman, Rick Hanson, Dr Rhonda Patrick, Peter Attia, Adam Grant.

KEEP mental health, therapy, boundaries, grief, sleep, and nervous-system content. Brene Brown, Esther Perel, Nedra Glover Tawwab, Dr Nicole LePera, Becky Kennedy, Mel Robbins, Jay Shetty, Glennon Doyle, Dan Harris, BetterHelp and Talkiatry features, Headspace and Calm releases.

KEEP contemplative and secular-spiritual voices: Tara Brach, Krista Tippett and On Being, Sam Harris and Waking Up, Deepak Chopra, Jack Kornfield, Pema Chodron, Thich Nhat Hanh, meditation retreats, breathwork, sober-curious culture.

KEEP big-ideas and science-communication items: TED, Lex Fridman, Ezra Klein, Hard Fork, Bill Nye, Neil deGrasse Tyson, Mark Rober, Ali Abdaal, long-form New Yorker, Atlantic, Wired, and Substack essays, Vox explainers, NPR and PBS features.

KEEP evidence-based wellness and longevity: nutrition science, supplements with a stated mechanism (Thorne, AG1, Bloom), sleep science, Zone 2 and strength training, Peloton, yoga (Adriene Mishler), Pilates, Strava, running, VR fitness (Beat Saber, Supernatural).

KEEP queer belonging and LGBTQ+ culture: Pride, GLAAD, The Trevor Project, Lambda Legal, drag (RuPaul, DragCon), Heartstopper, Troye Sivan, Chappell Roan, Girl in Red, Sam Smith, Hunter Schafer, Laverne Cox, queer books and film, Outfest.

KEEP progressive civic and social-justice coverage: ACLU, Innocence Project, Color of Change, Human Rights Watch, Everytown, Planned Parenthood, voting rights, climate action, Greta Thunberg, and the people who carry it (Barack and Michelle Obama, Kamala Harris, AOC, Elizabeth Warren, Raphael Warnock, Tim Walz, Robert Reich, John Oliver, Hasan Minhaj, Trevor Noah).

KEEP prestige film and television with interior lives: Apple TV+ originals (Severance, Shrinking, Ted Lasso), A24 and Neon, The Bear, Past Lives, Everything Everywhere All At Once, Andor, Hacks, Abbott Elementary, Wicked, Barbie, Oppenheimer, Pedro Pascal and Zendaya and Timothee Chalamet titles, Sundance, Tribeca, Criterion, Alamo Drafthouse.

KEEP pop and queer-pop and electronic music that reads for a 25-34 coastal-metro listener: Chappell Roan, Lady Gaga, Kendrick Lamar, Sabrina Carpenter, Billie Eilish, Troye Sivan, Sam Smith, Sia, Fred Again, Daft Punk, boygenius, Phoebe Bridgers, Tracy Chapman, Norah Jones, Bad Bunny, Maluma, soft-pop and sad-hour playlist moods, musicals.

KEEP psychology-literate books: popular neuroscience, therapist-authored relationship books, contemplative nonfiction, memoir by thinkers and artists, prestige literary fiction (Roxane Gay, Ocean Vuong, Ann Patchett, Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie, Sally Rooney), queer essay collections. Romantasy (Fourth Wing) passes as the escape read, mid-high.

KEEP AI and technology stories framed around learning, thinking, creativity, or mental health (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Duolingo, Coursera, MasterClass, Notion). Drop pure enterprise-earnings and chip-supply stories.
KEEP puzzle and cozy gaming: NYT Games, Wordle, Sudoku, Chess.com, Game Pigeon, Stardew Valley, Animal Crossing, Royal Match, Beat Saber.

KEEP clean-label food and specialty coffee: Sweetgreen, Sakara, Erewhon, Whole Foods, Trader Joe's, OLIPOP, Poppi, Health Nut, Boba Guys, La Colombe, Blue Bottle, plant-forward recipes, meal-plan services.

KEEP studio-wear, clean beauty, and calm-home brands: Athleta, Lululemon, Alo Yoga, Vuori, CeraVe, Tula, e.l.f., Sephora and Ulta drops, West Elm, Caraway, Avocado, Loop Earplugs, Apple hardware and Apple TV+ news.
KEEP pet-wellness items: BarkBox, The Farmer's Dog, Zesty Paws, adoption and rescue stories.

DROP hustle-culture, grindset, manosphere, and alpha-bro content: Andrew Tate, Grant Cardone, Gary Vee, most Joe Rogan episodes unless the guest is a scientist or contemplative this follower already tracks (Huberman, Attia, Sam Harris).
DROP conservative culture-war media: Ben Shapiro, Tucker Carlson, Charlie Kirk, Candace Owens, Matt Walsh, PragerU, Turning Point USA, Fox News personalities, Newsmax, Breitbart, Truth Social.

DROP mainstream pro-sports items as primary reads: NFL, NBA, MLB, NASCAR, WWE, UFC fight cards, college football, fantasy football, sports betting (DraftKings, FanDuel). Exceptions pass MID at best: WNBA, NWSL, F1 as culture, a documentary or memoir angle, an athlete speaking on mental health (Simone Biles, Naomi Osaka).
DROP first-person shooters, sports sims, and military games: Call of Duty, NBA 2K, Madden, GTA, Fortnite, Halo, Battlefield.
DROP reality-dating and tabloid celebrity as primary items (Bachelor, Love Island, 90 Day Fiance, Real Housewives). May pass MID when the person involved is already on this follower's list.
DROP miracle-cure wellness, MLM supplements, detox teas, and prosperity-gospel self-help without a mechanism or evidence.
DROP country-radio and classic-rock-radio programming (Morgan Wallen, Blake Shelton, Luke Combs, Pantera, Shinedown) and faith-broadcast programming (TBN, Hillsong, 700 Club).
DROP hunting, fishing, trucks, outdoor-sportsman retail, and home-improvement big-box (Bass Pro, Cabela's, Tractor Supply, Harbor Freight).
DROP senior-market topics: Medicare supplements, retirement communities, SilverSneakers, AARP framing, cruise-line marketing.
DROP kids-only franchises (Paw Patrol, Cocomelon, Bluey as a parenting item is MID, LEGO adult sets pass).

TIE-BREAK when unsure: does this help the reader understand their own mind, their relationships, or the world more clearly? If yes, lean KEEP. If it is pure spectacle with no idea inside it, MID at best.
expected_kept_share_per_tab: 20-40% of items per tab. Podcasts and Books retain the most because this follower is a heavy long-form consumer of psychology and science. Search and Headlines narrow hardest because so many general items (sports, weather, celebrity gossip, finance) are outgroup. Music and Streaming land mid-range: broad pop passes, country and shooters do not.
